column1: The Intellectual Life of the British Working Classes|2001|10|0|1945|8.5,7,6.5,7,7.5,8.5,5,9,7,7.5|Jonathan Rose|Uses memoirs, library records and surveys to explain self-education and access to cultural resources, not merely isolated lives. https://yalebooks.yale.edu/book/9780300259827/the-intellectual-life-of-the-british-working-classes/ establishes evidence base and original 2001 recognition; later editions do not reset age. Central preindustrial-to-mid-twentieth-century Britain, approximate endpoint 1945, low confidence. T11 national social history; T12=0 because education rather than political mobilization dominates. D=7.5 low-confidence estimate from description and review extracts: contrasting reading institutions add learning, while lengthy local detail may have lower yield. No whole-text density audit.

Too Much to Know|2010|0|0|1700|8.5,7.5,8,7.5,7.5,9,8.5,9,7,8|Ann M. Blair|History of information management, not a technical reference manual. Note-taking, indexing, compilation and printing explain constraints and adaptations with transferable value. https://yalebooks.yale.edu/book/9780300168495/too-much-to-know/ establishes 2010 and central sixteenth/seventeenth-century scope, endpoint approximately 1700 despite earlier contextual chapters. D=7.5 is a low-confidence contents/description estimate; specialized Latin compilation detail may reduce yield for this reader, but distinct methods are not redundant. No serious veto evidence found; no thematic deduction.

The Great Rift|2018|0|10|1642|7.5,7.5,6.5,7,6.5,8,8,8.5,7,7|Michael E. Hobart|Historical argument connecting mathematics as information technology with separation of scientific and religious explanation. Analytical treatment of religion is not doctrinal advocacy. https://www.kirkusreviews.com/book-reviews/michael-e-hobart/the-great-rift/ documents structure, readable numerical discussion and Galileo-centered development; endpoint 1642 is approximate for the central transformation rather than the modern framing. T12 philosophical relationship of science and religion. D=6.5 low confidence for long treatment based on review and contents; breadth offers learning, but sustained paragraph-level yield is unverified. Do not infer V1 from an ambitious synthesis alone.

The Book|2016|0|0||8,7.5,7,7.5,8,9,9,8,8.5,8|Keith Houston|Material history of paper, ink, typesetting, illustration and binding; explains production constraints and technical transitions, not a craft-training manual. https://catalog.freelibrary.org/Record/2047271 verifies 2016 and physical extent; https://www.kirkusreviews.com/book-reviews/keith-houston/the-book-cover-to-cover/ supplies detailed evidence of varied explanatory cases. D=8 low confidence from contents and independent review; detailed distinct processes support learning rather than mere repeated anecdotes. Broad cross-period account H13=0. T12=0: production technology is central, not media persuasion.

Glut: Mastering Information Through the Ages|2007|0|0||7.5,8,8,7,7.5,8.5,9,8,8,7.5|Alex Wright|Cross-period history of classification, storage and information networks. The title's promise of mastery does not make this an operational manual. https://openlibrary.org/works/OL15861476W/Glut and https://alexwright.com/about/bio/ establish original 2007 title, later republished as Informatica. Hierarchies, networks and information institutions provide transferable models; analogies across biology and culture require caution. D=7.5 low confidence from contents and review extracts, not full-text inspection. Broad sweep H13=0; no thematic deduction because information organization and technology dominate.

Cataloging the World|2014|0|0|1944|8,8,7.5,7.5,7.5,9,9,8.5,8,7.5|Alex Wright|Biography of Paul Otlet and his information systems, including classification, networked documents and institutional support. Eligible science/technology biography with explicit payload beyond the exception. https://alexwright.com/books/cataloging-the-world/ and https://alexwright.com/2014/03/cataloging-the-world.html verify 2014 and central lifetime ending 1944. Avoid treating anticipation as proof of direct causal ancestry of the Web. D=7.5 low-confidence estimate from contents and attributed specialist review extracts; distinct system designs add learning, private detail may have lower yield. No national-history deduction for a transnational information-science biography.

The Main Stream of Mathematics|1951|0|0||7.5,7,6.5,6.5,7,8,7.5,8.5,7,7|Edna E. Kramer|Historical and conceptual survey linking mathematics to science, art, music and industry; not primarily specialist training or proofs. https://mathshistory.st-andrews.ac.uk/Biographies/Kramer/ establishes 1951 and scope; https://www.abebooks.com/9780195006063/Main-Stream-Mathematics-Edna-Kramer-0195006062/plp describes removal of manipulative detail. Do not confuse with the larger 1970 Nature and Growth of Modern Mathematics. D=7 is a low-confidence description estimate; broad distinct applications offer learning, elementary exposition may be lower-yield for this reader. Broad cross-period development H13=0. Limited novelty lowers fit and utility rather than imposing an extra exclusion.

Critical Assembly|1993|10|0|1945|9,8,8,9,8.5,9.5,10,9.5,7.5,8|Lillian Hoddeson, Paul W. Henriksen, Roger A. Meade and Catherine L. Westfall|Technical history of discovery and engineering decisions, not a weapons-design curriculum. Cambridge preface and chapter extracts show research chronology, changing designs, materials constraints and laboratory organization: https://www.cambridge.org/core/books/critical-assembly/875AEBA3F62643970B7C3458B1B701AD/listing?pageNum=1 . Original 1993, central period 1943–1945. D=8.5 low confidence from sampled passages, contents and Bethe's specialist endorsement, not broad text coverage; distinct experimental failures and program transitions add learning. T11 US-centered institution; T12=0 because scientific engineering development dominates over war narrative. https://openlibrary.org/books/OL1732038M/Critical_assembly documents 509 numbered pages and references 418–492.
